visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a tight close-up on a ginger-colored tabby cat sitting on a yellow desk mat decorated with various cartoon cat illustrations. To the left of the frame, a fluffy, light-brown tail repeatedly swishes and brushes against the ginger cat's cheek and ear. The ginger cat maintains a steady, stoic gaze with its green eyes, looking slightly off-camera without reacting to the physical contact from the tail. In the background, a blurred computer monitor displays a desktop interface with visible icons, suggesting an indoor office or home study environment. (2) The camera angle remains consistent as a human hand with fair skin enters the frame from the lower left, reaching out to gently touch the ginger cat's right front paw. The cat's paw rests side-by-side with another white-furred paw, likely belonging to the second cat whose tail is moving. The ginger cat remains remarkably calm and still, its facial expression unchanged despite the tactile interaction and the constant movement of the tail nearby. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows across the scene. (3) The scene cuts to a solid black screen with white text centered in the frame, serving as a chronological transition. This title card marks the shift from the current-day footage to an archival clip. The visual style changes from high-definition modern video to a slightly lower-resolution and warmer-toned video clip from ten years ago. (4) In the final segment, two cats—an orange tabby and a white cat with brown patches—are shown standing on a polished wooden floor. Both cats are in a confrontational stance, with their bodies tensed and ears flattened slightly. The ginger tabby on the right sits while the white cat on the left stands, both with their mouths open in a clear display of hissing and aggressive growling. This contrast highlights their volatile relationship in the past compared to their current calm state.
